newsitem.title: UK: CU up on French pension fund tax news.
newsitem.headline: CU up on French pension fund tax news.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc rose on Wednesday on hopes that a change in French pension fund tax treatment would not damage the company's business as previously feared, analysts said.

Christian Sautter, junior minister responsible for the French budget, said today, "The principle of personal pension funds in addition to the pay-as-you go system is not being called into question. But we are looking for neutrality between the universal pay-as-you-go system and private pension funds from a fiscal point of view."

Sautter said the government was worried that companies would favour contributions to private pension funds over salaries because of favourable tax treatment under the pension fund law of the previous centre-right government.
About 30 percent of Commercial Union's business is in France.

"It looks now as though they won't scrap personal pensions as it was suggested although France may not be as generous as other countries in terms tax advantages on personal pensions," said Oliver Steel, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson insurance analyst.
Dealers and analysts said the sector had lagged the market recently also and was due a bounce.
Royal Sun Alliance Plc was 9p higher at 466-1/2p and Guardian Royal 8-1/2p up at 276p.
